title: あんたがたどこさ (Antagata Dokosa)
description: A traditional hand-ball bouncing song from Kumamoto (肥後手まり唄), following a chain of playful questions about a stranger's origin — 'Where are you from? Higo. Where in Higo? Kumamoto. Where in Kumamoto? Senba.' A tanuki on Senba Mountain then enters the story with a hunter close behind.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Japanese warabe-uta / 肥後手まり唄)
